prompt: Confirm the inspector role is structurally read-only — it can verify a Work Result but never repair it.

eval.contract: The inspector's declared agent tool scope (Read, Grep, Glob, Bash — no Write/Edit) and its InspectionReport output shape (subject_ref/verdict/findings/dispatch_identity, no patch/diff/fix field) together make the role structurally incapable of repairing what it inspects.
